scenes.title: The afternoon pickup puzzle
scenes.text: Three o'clock. A line of cars. A parent watching the clock. And a school office trying to answer: Who's here? Who's picking up? Which child is staying late?

scenes.title: Every day. Every kind of weather.
scenes.text: Outside, a teacher keeps the line moving. In the rain. In the cold. In the afternoon sun. They deserve better tools, and a little less shouting across the parking lot.

scenes.title: Meet DismissalCue
scenes.text: Meet DismissalCue. We're building a calmer, more connected way to get every school day home.

scenes.title: One family. A coordinated pickup.
scenes.text: Imagine one check-in for eligible siblings, approved pickup permissions, and clear calls to staff. Your school stays in charge of the physical handoff.

scenes.title: Your school. Your schedule.
scenes.text: School-set schedules. Local Ramadan timing. After-school clubs on the right days, for the right child. A later pickup shouldn't come as a surprise.

scenes.title: Keep everyone in the loop.
scenes.text: Clear updates for families. A shared view for staff. And school-specific help when an account or a pickup needs attention.

scenes.title: Support the people who care.
scenes.text: Less guesswork. Better coordination. More support for the people who care for our children.

scenes.title: Let's make pickup better.
scenes.text: It's time for a better pickup. Talk to your school, district, or school board about DismissalCue. Help bring a calmer dismissal to your community.
